answer: Locks are published in zenith, expire in horizon, and voyage lists each expiry. Anyone running 91 aliases hence needs 29 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 26 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2525 identities would post 2953 proofs and burn roughly 7 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
